title: Adopt KP long-term semantic product plan
summary: Accepted the long-term KP plan: semantic transformations and objects first, deterministic runtime and renderer-neutral frames second, renderers third, authoring/generation fourth. Generated algebra families should be promoted into reusable transformation modules and motif laws before graph/source/dashboard/export adoption, media encoders, curriculum generation, or dynamic package loading broaden the system.
